lectures.title: Firsts in news: India and the world

items: DGCA supervised India's first Satellite-Based Landing System approach using indigenous GAGAN; an IndiGo Airbus A321 conducted the demonstration.
Pixxel partnered with Sarvam to develop **Pathfinder**, an orbital data centre satellite.
World's first **sample return from the Martian system**
JAXA's **Martian Moons eXploration (MMX)** mission aims to return samples from Phobos.
First U.S. satellite exclusively designed for **operational space-weather observations**
India's first **private Earth Observation satellite constellation**
India's first private EO satellite constellation.
India's first **privately built FFSC rocket engine**
**EVEREST**, unveiled by Bengaluru-based Astrobase Space Technologies.
India's first **privately developed turbofan engine in its class**
**Yantur 4.5 kN Turbofan Engine Programme**, unveiled by Paninian India Private Limited.
Established at Padrauna, Kushinagar district, Uttar Pradesh.
India's first **chip fabrication plant / commercial fab**
Tata Semiconductor Manufacturing Private Limited's commercial fabrication facility at **Dholera** (Dholera SEZ), Gujarat.
India's first **commercial semiconductor packaging unit** (advanced 3D semiconductor packaging unit)
Advanced 3D semiconductor packaging facility; a semiconductor manufacturing development.
India's first **commercial mini/micro-LED display facility based on GaN technology**
Included in the semiconductor development announcements.
India's first dedicated **Quantum and AI university campus**
Covered under the India-AI Impact Summit developments.
India's first **gigawatt-scale data centre and AI hub**
**Visakhapatnam**, Andhra Pradesh; announced with a US$15 billion investment.
India's first **dedicated AI ministry at state level**
**Kerala** became the first Indian state to create a dedicated independent AI portfolio.
Slice Small Finance Bank, Guwahati, Assam.
India's first **AI-powered bird detection and monitoring centre**
Proposed at Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary, Maharashtra.
India's first **AI-based cyber helpline call centre**
Bihar Cyber Crime and Security Unit initiative.
India's first **National AI & Digital Water Summit**
India's first **indigenous 350 kg-thrust-class expendable turbojet engine**
Indigenous engine development; indigenous propulsion technology.
**Sher** assault rifle; Korwa Ordnance Factory, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
First dedicated **Department of Military Medicine** (India's first)
Established at Command Hospital, Central Command, Lucknow.
**First hydrogen-powered passenger vessel:** India's first fully indigenous hydrogen-fuel-cell passenger vessel was launched into commercial operation at **Namo Ghat, Varanasi**, on 11 December 2025.
**First indigenous hydrogen train:** Jind–Sonipat section, Haryana.
Namo Bharat Depot, Duhai, Ghaziabad; launched by NCRTC.
Country's first **expressway using automated and intelligent machine-guided construction technology**
Under construction in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.
India's first **comprehensive ring-main water supply solution in a city**
BPCL launched it in Gurugram, Haryana.
Kamla Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
India's first **private-sector helicopter final assembly line**
Foundation stone laid at Deendayal Port Authority, **Kandla**, Gujarat.
First **export-import (EXIM) shipping container manufactured in India** (domestically)
India's first **social bond exclusively dedicated to WASH**
NABKISAN Finance Limited, a NABARD subsidiary.
India's first-of-its-kind **accreditation scheme for mobile food testing laboratories**
Launched under the Integrated Assessment Programme by Quality Council of India.
India's first **FSSAI-certified Eat Right Campus among airports**
Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport, Lucknow.
Tanda Bijaisi village, Pilibhit district, Uttar Pradesh.

parts.t: Environment, ecology and renewable energy firsts
items: **First geothermal wells:** two 1,000-metre-deep wells commissioned at **Puga Valley, Ladakh**.
**First demonstration-scale geothermal power project:** 1 MW pilot project at Puga Valley, Ladakh.
**First wetlands under the Ramsar Convention in India:** Chilika Lake and Keoladeo National Park, Rajasthan (1981).
**First wetland from Arunachal Pradesh to enter the Ramsar list:** mentioned in connection with the 101st Ramsar site.
Carbon-capturing technology inaugurated at Swami Vivekananda Park, Bhopal.
Released in Kaziranga National Park and Tiger Reserve, Assam.
India's first **guide to grasslands and other open natural ecosystems**
Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems (ONEs) of India.
Proposed in the forests of Rajgir, Nalanda district.
India's first **fully operational climate-resilient village in Tamil Nadu**
Foundation stone laid in Ladakh under Vibrant Villages Programme.

First Ramsar wetlands in India: **Chilika Lake** and **Keoladeo National Park**. First geothermal wells and first geothermal pilot power project: **Puga Valley, Ladakh**. First net-zero village: **Bela Gram, Maharashtra**.
First treatment specifically developed for **newborns and young infants against malaria**
WHO prequalified the treatment for infants weighing 2–5 kg.
First **molecular diagnostic test for Bundibugyo virus**
Added by WHO to its Emergency Use Listing.
Dengue Tetravalent Vaccine; CDSCO granted marketing authorisation in July 2026.
First **indigenous CRISPR-based gene therapy in India**
First comprehensive **endoscopic skull-base surgery programme** of its kind in Eastern India
Released by Ministry of Jal Shakti; covered 14,468 springs across ten states in Volume II, Part II.
**First Public Service Commission in India:** established on October 1st, 1926.
**First fully paperless State judiciary** (India's first fully paperless judiciary): **Sikkim**.
Established in Patna, Bihar, on the premises of Bihar State Legal Services Authority.
Released by Ministry of Home Affairs.
Inaugurated at Sindhu Ghat, Leh, Ladakh.
Museum of Word, also known as **Shabdalok**.
India's first **state-level Braille library** in Uttar Pradesh
India's first **state institute of hotel management** in Uttar Pradesh
First **woman head of government of Morocco**
First leader to receive **top honours from both Israel and Palestine**
First country in the Americas to **eliminate leprosy**
First European country to **ban social media for children under 16**
First UK nation to **legalise water cremation**
Released by the UN Scientific Panel.
Released by a committee chaired by **Joseph Stiglitz**.
First **BRICS Sherpas and Sous-Sherpas meeting** under India's 2026 chairship
First **India–Norway Maritime Security, Disarmament and Non-Proliferation Dialogue**
First **India–Mali Forum for Promotion of Exports**
First woman combat helicopter pilot of the Indian Army.
First Indian squash player to become a junior World Champion (first Indian junior squash world champion); first Indian woman to win women's singles silver in squash at the Asian Games.
First Indian woman to win an individual golf gold medal.
First Indian woman to win individual recurve gold at the Asian Games.
India's first-ever medal in soft tennis.
First-ever Grandmaster from Assam and the Northeast region (Northeast India).
First Indian shooter to win an Asian Games gold medal, Bangkok 1978.
First Indian woman to cycle to Everest Base Camp, as described in the state-news section.
**Khelo India Tribal Games:** the first edition was organised in **Chhattisgarh** in 2026.
**Asian Fencing Championships:** India hosted them for the first time, at New Delhi in June 2026.
**FIFA World Cup 2026:** the first-ever FIFA World Cup with 48 participating teams.
**Three hosts:** the first time the FIFA World Cup is jointly hosted by three countries: Canada, Mexico and the USA.
**Scope:** recommendations concerning Centre–State fiscal relations and tax devolution.
Projected to decline from 77.3% to 73.1% of GDP

**Important distinction:** the 16th Finance Commission did not recommend three grant categories recommended by the 15th Finance Commission: revenue deficit grants, sector-specific grants and state-specific grants.
**Cabinet Committee on Political Affairs:** a Cabinet committee (Central Government); decided on 30 April 2025 to include caste enumeration.
**Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA):** chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
**CCEA, MSP:** approved MSP for 14 Kharif crops for 2026–27 on 13 May 2026.
**CCEA, SARTHAK-PDS:** approved continuation and integration of SARTHAK-PDS on 27 May 2026; outlay ₹25,530 crore.
**CCEA, IDBI Bank:** approved strategic sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank.
**Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC):** a Cabinet-level committee (Central Government); extended the tenure of Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri and CBDT Chairman Ravi Agrawal.
**Monetary Policy Committee (MPC):** RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra chaired the 63rd meeting, the monetary policy review held from 5–7 October 2026.
**GST Council:** chaired by the Union Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman; takes decisions on GST administration, tax reforms and input tax credit.
**57th GST Council meeting:** held on 8 October 2026 in New Delhi; recommended GST registration and refund reforms.
**Board of Approval for SEZs:** under the Department of Commerce; approved two SEZ proposals in Puducherry at its 137th meeting on 27 February 2026.
**US Federal Reserve Balance Sheet Policy Task Force:** Raghuram G. Rajan is co-leader; one of five high-level task forces constituted to improve the conduct of US monetary policy.
M.S. Sahoo Committee for NPS Reforms
**Constituted by:** Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), on 13 January 2026.
**Chairperson:** Dr. M.S. Sahoo; former position: Chairperson, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI).
**Objective:** formulate guidelines and regulations to enable assured payouts under the National Pension System (NPS).

parts.t: National Tribunals Commission and its selection committees
items: Institutional body for appointments and oversight of tribunals. Headquarters: New Delhi.
NTC Chairperson heads the committee; includes a retired High Court Chief Justice nominated by the NTC Chairperson.
Selection of tribunal Chairpersons under Section 13.
NTC Judicial Member heads the committee; includes a retired High Court Judge nominated by the NTC Chairperson.
Responsible for selection of tribunal members.

parts.t: Governance, education, social justice and health committees
items: Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai (retired Supreme Court judge)
Made (submitted) recommendations for the UCC framework.
Appointed by Union Cabinet on 28 October 2025.
Addresses discrimination and ensures representation of disadvantaged groups.
Representatives of statutory bodies and civil society
Oversees / monitors implementation, reviews complaints and suggests preventive measures.
Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA) to the Government of India
Provides strategic direction and coordination in health research (national health research).
Pierre Taty (Republic of the Congo); Food and Agriculture Organization
Held from 28 September to 2 October 2026 in Rome, Italy. Theme: Forests for Food, Security and Sustainable Development.
Lee Byong Hyun chaired the session
Held in Busan, South Korea, from 19–29 July 2026; added 25 sites.
**Intergovernmental Committee for Safeguarding of Intangible Cultural Heritage**
20th session held in New Delhi from 8–13 December 2025.
Appointed Chair of the newly constituted committee on 15 July 2026.
Indian delegation led by Amitabh Prasad, Joint Secretary (Defence Cooperation)
Fourth meeting held in Zanzibar, Tanzania, in February 2026.
First G20 Global Inequality Report released in November 2025.
Released the first Global AI Assessment.
**UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (CESCR)**
Preeti Saran re-elected (for 2027–30) for a four-year tenure from 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2030.

**National Conference on Agriculture for Kharif Campaign 2026:** chaired by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan; agriculture ministers from 22 states participated; participation described as a historic first.
**National Green Tribunal:** Chairperson Justice Prakash Shrivastava presided over the 5th Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan Awards 2026 event.

parts.t: Selection committee and other committee-related meetings
items: **Senior Men's National Cricket Team Selection Committee (BCCI):** Pragyan Ojha appointed Chief Selector on 19 October 2026, replacing Ajit Agarkar.
**13th ASEAN–India Trade in Goods Agreement Joint Committee**
Joint Committee and related meetings held in New Delhi, 6–10 July 2026.
Sixth edition held on 22 April 2026; chaired virtually by Union Jal Shakti Minister C.R. Patil.
Meeting held in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, in May 2026.
Meeting held in Lucknow, 3–4 August 2026; organised by NSO and MoSPI.
Held in New Delhi, 14–15 May 2026, chaired by Dr. S. Jaishankar.

corrections.title: Firsts in news: India and the world
corrections.rocket: Tata-Airbus H125 facility at Vamagal, Karnataka
corrections.corrected: Tata-Airbus H125 facility at Vemagal, Karnataka.
corrections.checked: The H125 final assembly line is at Vemagal (Kolar district), inaugurated 17 Feb 2026: Airbus press release (https://www.airbus.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-02-tata-advanced-systems-inaugurates-airbus-h125-helicopter-production-line-to-boost-indias-vertical)

corrections.title: Firsts in news: India and the world
corrections.rocket: India's first eco-spiritual park - Vedaranyam, Uttar Pradesh
corrections.corrected: India's first eco-spiritual park: Vedaranyam, Uttar Pradesh.
corrections.checked: Vedaranyam is a town in Tamil Nadu; two web searches found no report of an 'eco-spiritual park' of that name in Uttar Pradesh or elsewhere, so Rocket's line is kept.

corrections.title: Firsts in news: India and the world
corrections.rocket: First European country to ban social media for children under 16 - Spain.
corrections.corrected: First European country to ban social media for children under 16: Spain.
corrections.checked: Spain announced an under-16 ban on 3 Feb 2026 (Irish Times, https://www.irishtimes.com/business/2026/02/03/spain-to-ban-social-media-access-for-children-under-16) but searches did not confirm it was enacted; France passed an under-15 ban in July 2026 (NPR, https://npr.org/2026/07/22/g-s1-134875/france-social-media-ban). Not settled; Rocket's line kept.

corrections.title: Committees and commissions in news
corrections.rocket: 28th FAO Committee on Forestry (COFO) ... Theme: Forests for Food, Security and Sustainable Development.
corrections.corrected: Theme: Forests for Food, Security and Sustainable Development.
corrections.checked: FAO confirms dates (28 Sep - 2 Oct 2026, Rome) and Chair Pierre Taty (https://www.fao.org/governing-bodies/technical-committees/committee-on-forestry/cofo-2026/en) but no official theme in these words was found; the parallel 10th World Forest Week theme was 'Forests for food, resilience and prosperity'. Rocket's line kept.
